default.note: The shipped field battle: Campus Martius, ultra order of battle, quality=high, 8,632 men. Recorded at 88a4aa5. Re-record only in the same commit as the change that moved it.

map=campus-martius&scenario=assault.note: Rome's assault. Re-recorded for THIS pass's change and no other: CitySystem.masonryTopAt gained a tower branch. A tower is stamped into the obstacle set as a solid box towerHalf square rising towerRise above the crest, but the projectile height field had no tower test at all -- it resolved a bay and tested the curtain cross-section, so it answered walkY 52.80 at the centre of a tower standing to 59.85, and every shot that reached the upper storey flew through it. Measured on Rome at 7dd9616: a lofted onager stone aimed into a tower crossed the whole footprint and landed 37 m inside the city. Towers now report their own roof, so stones stop on them; the movement is entirely garrison casualties NOT taken behind a tower that used to be transparent -- alive at t+200 2186 -> 2229. Determinism itself is intact: runs A and B are bit-identical at every checkpoint in both arms, and the field battle (default) did not move at all. Re-record only in the same commit as the change that moved it.
